The rules decide it: two people in the same team scene or battle who never deal with each other get no stage ('the same battle without an exchange... say none'). The existing ties stay under 'Implied ties stay'.
Glorious Purpose: across Loki's loops Sylvie fights past him and stabs He Who Remains, who laughs at and taunts her and freezes her in place with his TemPad.
Science/Fiction: Loki finds B-15 living as Verity Willis and brings her via TemPad to Doug's group to read their temporal aura; the show treats Willis as B-15's own original life.
Heart of the TVA: B-15 arrives and says Dox was killed, and Sylvie realizes Renslayer is responsible; both are with the group at the Loom.

value.title: Loki S2#3
value.text: At the 1893 World's Fair, Miss Minutes poses as a giant ghost clock and chases Sylvie off so Renslayer can escape with Timely.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Variant she chases off at the World's Fair.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The TVA's A.I., who chases Sylvie off at the World's Fair.

verdicts.why: The ghost-clock chase is right. But Sylvie pushes Renslayer, not Miss Minutes, to the Citadel: Miss Minutes is switched off and Renslayer turns her back on there, so that part is between Sylvie and a third person.
